reading_guide: Each row is a project-owned restatement of an obligation. It is not specification text and is not a substitute for the pinned source.

implementation_state stays 'not-audited' unless a full-row audit links exact evidence. A public entry point existing is recorded only in baseline.surface_state, which is not evidence of contract compliance.
cts.mapping is a static join against the pinned CTS listing. No row claims a case passed; runtime results live in evidence.runtime.
Rows never treat skipped, unmapped or unexecuted tests as passes.
